summary: amazon.aws removals: iam_role/iam_role_info assume_role_policy_document_raw is deprecated because assume_role_policy_document now returns the same raw format, and module_utils.policy sort_json_policy_dict() is removed in favor of compare_policies().
questions: What replaces sort_json_policy_dict in amazon.aws module utils?

answer_card.title: amazon.aws iam_role policy document changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `iam_role` / `iam_role_info`: `assume_role_policy_document` now returns the raw format, so `assume_role_policy_document_raw` is deprecated.
- `module_utils.policy.sort_json_policy_dict()` is removed. Use `compare_policies()`.
